meta.title: [WIP] Further remove dependency of Compatibility.Layout on all modern .NET MAUI controls
meta.body_summary: Work-in-progress PR adding bypass logic to Compatibility.Layout and removing legacy dependencies to improve performance of modern .NET MAUI controls; maintainer guided Copilot to copy baseline changes from another PR and fix build errors.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot WIP refactoring to bypass legacy layout logic; maintainer guided agent to copy baseline and fix builds; PR closed after successful test run with no merge or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 5754 changed lines across 72 files, this is a large-scale refactor by absolute volume. The PR was a work-in-progress aimed at reducing legacy dependencies; it was closed without merge after maintainer guided the agent through iterations, including copying another PR's changes and fixing build errors. This is consistent with a complex refactoring that may be integrated later into a larger branch or served as a testing workspace, not a standalone merge.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer PureWeen instructed Copilot to copy all changes from PR #29281 to establish a baseline, then to fix build errors and run unit tests, indicating a focus on integration and correctness rather than performance validation.
review_details.performance_claim: Reducing dependency on Compatibility.Layout improves performance of modern MAUI controls by bypassing legacy layout logic.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed after successful build/test run without merge; likely intended as a collaborative workspace rather than a mergeable branch.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Maintainer used Copilot as an assistant to replicate another PR's baseline and fix build errors; the PR served as a workspace for a larger compatibility removal effort and was closed without independent merge, indicating a process boundary where the agent's output is integrated manually by the maintainer.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer PureWeen reviewed the PR plan and provided step-by-step instructions to copy a baseline and fix build errors, without formal review.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Copilot ran the unit test suite and reported 5207 passed, 30 skipped, 0 failed, which the maintainer used to verify no regressions.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance metrics, benchmark, or profiling provided; only a narrative claim of improved performance.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed after successful test run; no regression occurred.

core_change_summary.description: Added bypass logic in Compatibility.Layout to skip legacy methods for ScrollView, ContentPresenter, and TemplatedView; introduced shared helpers (ClippedToBoundsElement, InputTransparentContainerElement); applied baseline changes from PR #29281 including removal of CarouselPage and compatibility renderers; fixed build errors and added missing extension methods for unit tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test and public API files were updated to reflect the refactoring; many compatibility renderers were removed in the baseline commit.

Fixed build errors and added missing extension methods; reported all tests passing.
